verdict.rationale: Medusa is a headless commerce platform. Its repository maintains complete OpenAPI 3.0 specs for both the Store and Admin REST APIs, which power the API reference, so admin operations are exposed programmatically alongside the dashboard. The probe's 404s at well-known docs paths only show where the spec isn't published; they don't contradict that it exists in the repo. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the Admin dashboard is built entirely on the Admin API (UI/API parity statement), and independent or hands-on corroboration that every UI action is available via API.
